definitions.explanation: A prepared medicine or chemical substance used for medical treatment, scientific research, or industrial purposes. More technical than {薬|くすり}, and often used in professional or scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {薬剤|やくざい}{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{薬剤|やくざい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This pharmaceutical is said to have few side effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{薬剤|やくざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{膨大|ぼうだい}→膨大：08997_boudai⟧な⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Developing a new pharmaceutical takes many years and enormous costs.

notes:
USAGE:
{薬剤|やくざい} is a formal, technical term for medicines and chemical agents. It is far more common in professional, medical, and scientific contexts than in everyday speech, where ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧ is preferred.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {薬剤|やくざい}{師|し} (pharmacist)
- {薬剤|やくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投与|とうよ}→投与：12894_touyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (administer a drug)
- {薬剤|やくざい}⟦{耐性|たいせい}→耐性：13917_taisei⟧ (drug resistance)
- {薬剤|やくざい}⟦{散布|さんぷ}→散布：21064_sanpu⟧ (spraying chemicals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine (everyday term)
- ⟦{医薬品|いやくひん}→医薬品：19711_iyakuhin⟧: pharmaceutical product (regulatory/official term)
- ⟦{薬品|やくひん}→薬品：11055_yakuhin⟧: chemicals (broader, includes non-medical chemicals)
